CMEAnalysis.note: Somewhat speculative analysis based on SOHO LASCO C2 imagery and on the very approximate location of the AR rotating onto the visible disk and seen on/behind the east limb in SDO AIA 193/304.

Approximate analysis based exclusively on the fit of the narrow front in two coronagraphs (SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2); longitude of 143 deg seems to be the highest longitude allowing the fit. This analysis is partially confirmed by the possible source - a lifting filament seen in STEREO A EUV 304 close to the west limb as seen from STEREO A (close to 159 degrees).
Triangulation between STEREO A COR2 and SOHO LASCO C2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2. The front appears more wide in COR2 than C3, as such COR2's width is used.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2, very faint in LASCO but trackable.

STEREO A COR2 only analysis using the source N03W32 as a basis, as such the parameters could vary. In STEREO A COR2, there is a faint leading edge observed already far in the east field-of-view after a data gap ends at 2026-09-24T01:23Z that better corresponds to te eruption time, but also plausible to match this leading edge.
GOES CCOR-1 and STEREO A COR2 triangulation, full width and leading edge somewhat obscured by this front's overlap with the preceeding streamer blowout.
Measurement of the wider, fainter, shock feature of the CME based on the best fit between STEREO A COR2, SOHO LASCO C2/C3, and GOES CCOR-1 imagery in SWPC_CAT.
Updated measurement of the leading edge based on the best fit between STEREO A COR2, GOES CCOR-1, and SOHO LASCO C2/C3 imagery in SWPC_CAT.

Very speculative analysis based on the location of the possible source (a faint filament eruption seen in STEREO A EUV 195) and on the front seen only in one coronagraph (STEREO A COR2) since the CME is not seen in other coronagraphs.
Measurement based on best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.

Analysis based on the fit of the front with two coronagraphs, SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2 and confirmed by the approximate location of the source filament eruption. There might be some eastward deflection from the source.
Measurement based on best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
BULK measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.
SHOCK measurement based on approximate source  location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.

Measurement based on the approximate source longitude. As this event is not visible in STEREO A COR2 imagery, a triangulated measurement was not available. The measured parameters may vary slightly as a result.

Measurement based on the approximate source longitude. As this event is not visible in STEREO A COR2 imagery, a triangulated measurement was not available. The measured parameters may vary slightly as a result.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and GOES CCOR-1.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2. CME is thin (HW slightly <10 degrees) and somewhat deflected, but still tracks a decent fit between the coronagraphs.
Updated 3D analysis via SWPC_CAT triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2. This analysis finds the CME further east around W112, but still high latitude and narrow.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3, STEREO A COR2, and GOES CCOR-1 in SWPC_CAT as well as the potential source location.
Measurement based on the potential source location as well as the best fit between STEREO A COR2, SOHO LASCO C3, and GOES CCOR-1 imagery in SWPC_CAT.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT as well as potential source location.
SOHO LASCO C2 only 3D analysis using observed source longitude of W62, as such the parameters may slightly vary.
SOHO LASCO C2 only 3D analysis using observed source longitude of W62, as such the parameters may slightly vary.

Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2. This analysis encompasses the entire observed front as the bulk leading edge with no discernable shock, taking note of the brighter inner core.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2, the front is quite faint but still trackable in early frames.

SOHO LASCO C3 only 3D analysis using the source W71, as such the parameters may vary. There is a concurrent SW feature in COR2A that does not triangulate to this SOHO LASCO feature and is ruled a separate event, so SOHO-only is used here.

Bulk leading edge triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2, noting the slightly distorted shape of the bright LE affecting analysis of the width. This analysis is initially preliminary, but may stand as final LE.

Shock triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2, noting the asymmetric shape of the shock especially in the LASCO C2/C3 field-of-view. This analysis is initially preliminary, but may stand as final SH.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.
Measured longitude based on the on-disk source location.
Triangulation betweeen SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2. The CME front is much more faint in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, so the width in COR2 is used primarily.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Preliminary shock measurement using the best fit between GOES CCOR-1 and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT.
Updated measurement of the leading edge of the CME based on the source location as well as the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2 imagery.

Measurement based on potential source location as well as best fit between SOHO LASCO C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2. There were two measurable frames of STEREO A COR2 imagery available for this measurement. There may be some deflection of the CME.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT. Due to the CME's faintness, this CME measurement is more approximate than usual.
Measurement based on the potential source location. STEREO A COR2 was not available for triangulation of this measurement.
Measurement based on source location using GOES CCOR-1 imagery.

Analysis based on the location of the source (the M1.3 flare from Active Region 14547 (N15W94) which had just rotated off the visible disk before the flare) and on imagery from SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and GOES CCOR-1 The CME is fully covered by long data gap in STEREO A COR2 coronagraph, so this analysis is not confirmed by STEREO A.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Bulk measurement. SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and GOES CCOR-1 fit using W54 as the flare longitude, given no available STEREO A COR2 to triangulate with.

SHOCK analysis, somewhat speculative using SOHO LASCO C2/C3 only (CCOR-1 observes the shock, but does not track perfectly between what is seen in LASCO, with no usable STEREO A COR2 imagery available to triangulate). This analyzed longitude is significantly far from the eruptive source around W54 degrees, but the entire shock front does not otherwise fit within the swpc_cat tool at more western longitudes.
Analysis based on the fit of the narrow NE fronts in STEREO A COR2 and SOHO LASCO C2.
Measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Measured longitude based on the source location. Due to a data gap in STEREO A COR2 imagery, a triangulated measurement was not available and the measured parameters may vary slightly as a result.

Measurement based on the approximate source location. Although this leading edge for this event is outside of the STEREO A COR2 field of view, this imagery was used as a guide to find the best fitting parameters between SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.
Measurement based on the approximate source location and best fit between SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.

3D STEREO A COR2 Science Data only analysis, fitting to the approximate center of the eruptive source ~S16E13 and finding northward deflection. Science data imagery is used due to a real-time STEREO A COR2 beacon data gap spanning 2026-10-08T18:53Z to 2026-10-09T17:53Z, and no leading edge observations in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.

Measurement using limited available frames of STEREO A COR2 imagery before the leading edge of the CME becomes too faint to measure. The measurement is based on the approximate source location and is approximate due to the possible deflection of the eruption and the eruption's longitudinal extent.
Analysis based on the fit of the clear front in two coronagraphs (SOHO LASCO and STEREO A COR2) and confirmed by the somewhat approximate location of the source in EUV imagery.
Measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.

3D GOES CCOR-1 only fit using the observed approximate longitude of W130 as a basis, finding significantly northward deflection (also true for a plane-of-sky), as such parameters for this event may vary. With the large coronal hole proximity, this is not an unreasonable deflection.
Measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on best fit between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Updated measurement based on source location and later frames of SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.

Shock triangulation with SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2. The shock front is notably difficult to observe in COR2 imagery, and the width from LASCO and CCOR-1 is best used for the fit. As such, the parameters may vary slightly.
Preliminary bulk triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2, but a good fit of the brightest material and may be final analysis.
Measurement based on the approximate source location and best fit between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.
Measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.

Approximate analysis based on the fit of the narrow front of this jet in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and the STEREO A COR2 coronagraphs and not confirmed by source location, as no source has been found in the EUV imagery.

Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2. This analysis includes the fainter northern lobe of the front in SOHO LASCO C2/C3; with no separate source indication and traveling together they are analyzed as one. Front is harder to observe in STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2, noting STEREO misses most of the CME and there is difficulty tracking the front only at the edge of its field-of-view.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2.

Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2. Despite the source location around S05W80, the fit does not work unless it is around W45-W50, so we may be observing significant deflection not seen well in corresponding EUV imagery.

Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2. Despite the source location around S09W72, the fit does not work unless it is around W40-W50, so we may be observing significant deflection not seen well in corresponding EUV imagery.
Measurement based on the source longitude.
Measurement based on the source longitude.
Measurement based on the source longitude.

Updated measurement based on available STEREO A COR2 and SOHO LASCO C3 imagery in SWPC_CAT. The measurement is based on the source location as well as the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT.
Measurement based on the best fit between GOES CCOR-1, SOHO LASCO C2/C3, and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT as well as the potential source location.
Triangulation between GOES CCOR-1, SOHO LASCO C2, and STEREO A COR2.

SOHO LASCO C2/C3 only 3D analysis using the estimated source observation ~S10W95 as a basis. As such, the parameters may vary slightly. The front is barely visible in STEREO A COR2 white light imagery but not reliably resolvable in its running difference imagery for triangulation.
Measurement based on the approximate source location and best fit between SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.

An approximate analysis based on the location of the (very minor) source and the imagery in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 coronagraphs and not confirmed by triangulation since the front is not seen in STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and GOES CCOR-1.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2, STEREO A COR2 and GOES CCOR-1.

Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2 and one frame usable frame of STEREO A COR2, noting poor quality COR2 imagery affecting front visibility beyond one frame into a real-time data gap starting 2026-11-01T19:38Z.
Updated measurement with later frames of STEREO A COR2 to provide a 3D longitude fit.
Updated measurement using late frames of STEREO A COR2 to provide a 3D fit.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3, STEREO A COR2, and GOES CCOR-1 imagery as well as the potential source location.

Updated measurement following a backfill in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 data. This measurement is based on the source location. Deflection to the East is possible for this CME due to its proximity to a coronal hole.

This measurement is based on the best fit between STEREO A COR2, SOHO LASCO C2/C3, and GOES CCOR-1 imagery in SWPC_CAT as well as the potential source location. Due to the faintness of the CME's leading edge in STEREO A COR2, there may be more uncertainty than usual in this measurement.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT.
Measurement based on the potential source location.

Measurement based on the best fit between GOES CCOR-1 and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT as well as the potential source location. Only two frames of STEREO A COR2 imagery were available for a measurement. The majority of the fit uses GOES CCOR-1 imagery.
Measurement based on the approximate source location using GOES CCOR-1 and SOHO LASCO C2/C3 imagery.

Measurement of the wider, fainter, potential shock feature of the CME. This shock feature appears to move more eastward than the leading edge and bulk of the CME as seen in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 imagery. STEREO A COR2 imagery was not available, so this measurement is approximate.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2, noting a deflected front making tracking with the swpc_cat tool difficult.
Measurement based on potential source location using GOES CCOR-1 imagery.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
GOES CCOR-1 only 3D fit to the observed source at W65, as such parameters may vary slightly. CME half with is slightly less than 10 degrees, limited by swpc_cat analysis tool.
Preliminary triangulation between GOES CCOR-1 and STEREO A COR2. The streamer blowout may speed up to reanalyze later, but if not this analysis is considered final.
Triangulation between GOES CCOR-1 and STEREO A COR2, finding significant deflection westward to ~W90-W100 from the source observed at W72.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and GOES CCOR-1.

Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery. The leading edge of the CME is unclear, so this measurement is more approximate than usual and based on the fastest portion of the CME prior to it leaving the field of view of STEREO A COR2.

Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2 imagery. This measurement only uses one frame of available SOHO LASCO C2 imagery and is primarily based on STEREO A COR2 imagery.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT.
